# Tambena Consulting

> > Tambena Consulting provides custom software development, DevOps, CRM solutions, and payment gateway services with expertise in Python, Java, PHP, AWS, and MongoDB.

Based in Atlanta, Tambena Consulting serves healthcare, fintech, edtech, retail, and real estate industries with tailored web development, cloud infrastructure, and data management solutions. The company specializes in enterprise-grade custom development alongside modern AI-powered tools and security best practices.

## Key Topics

- Custom Software Development
- DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
- CRM Development & Integration
- Payment Gateway Solutions
- Python, Java, PHP Development
- AWS & MongoDB
- OpenStack Consulting
- Web Application Security
- Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
- Healthcare, Fintech, Edtech Solutions
- AI & No-Code Tools
- Data Governance & Management
- Motion Graphics & UI/UX
- Local SEO & Client Acquisition
- DevSecOps Best Practices

## Core Services

- [Custom Payment Gateway | Tambena Consulting](https://www.tambenaconsulting.com/custom-payment-gateway-white-label): Custom white-label payment gateway development with PCI compliance

- [Software & Web Solutions For Big Industries | Tambena Consulting](https://www.tambenaconsulting.com/industries): Industry solutions: healthcare, fintech, edtech, retail, real estate
- [OpenStack DevOps Services | OpenStack Consulting | Tambena Consulting](https://www.tambenaconsulting.com/openstack-devops-services): OpenStack DevOps with Python, Node.js, React.js API development
